newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Bancorp completes Sun Capital acquisition.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Bancorp completes Sun Capital acquisition.

text.p: U.S. Bancorp said Tuesday it had completed its acquisition of Sun Capital Bancorp and its subsidiary bank, Sun Capital Bank.
In September, the company said the deal was worth about $15.5 million.
The company said it would merge Sun Capital's three branches into a single operation called U.S. Bank of Utah.
Sun Capital Bank, based in St. George, Utah, is a $70 million financial services company.
U.S. Bancorp is a bank holding company with assets of more than $33 billion.
